## Why This Benchmark Is Included

Transparent end-to-end decoder-only Transformer workload.

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Classroom value** | Model and training loop are small enough to inspect completely. |
| **Systems behavior** | Attention training, autoregressive inference, and KV-cache phases. |
| **Benchmark lineage** | Upstream publishes the configuration, runtime, and validation loss. |
| **Model choice** | nanoGPT is an established educational reference with an exact recipe. |
| **Dataset choice** | Tiny Shakespeare is the upstream quick-start dataset. |
| **Quality metric** | Validation cross-entropy is emitted by the upstream training recipe. |
| **Published baseline** | 1.4697 best validation loss |
| **Alternative rejected** | Project-defined prompt quality is not a language-model quality contract. |

## How to Run

```bash
# prepare and quality-check the training checkpoint
OUTPUT_DIR="submissions/causal-language-modeling-max"
uv run mlperf fetch --workload causal-language-modeling --profile max
uv run mlperf run --workload causal-language-modeling --mode training --profile max --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR"
uv run mlperf run --workload causal-language-modeling --mode inference --phase full --profile max --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR"
uv run mlperf run --workload causal-language-modeling --mode inference --phase prefill --profile max --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR"
uv run mlperf run --workload causal-language-modeling --mode inference --phase decode --profile max --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR"

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload causal-language-modeling --profile min
uv run mlperf run --workload causal-language-modeling --mode inference --phase full --profile min
uv run mlperf run --workload causal-language-modeling --mode inference --phase prefill --profile min
uv run mlperf run --workload causal-language-modeling --mode inference --phase decode --profile min

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload causal-language-modeling --profile pro --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR"
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.

## Systems Experiment Execution Contract

**Within-run measurement protocol:**

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Primary metric** | train_and_eval_seconds |
| **Scenario** | training |
| **Timing scope** | pinned nanoGPT 5,001-step training loop including scheduled train and validation loss estimation |
| **Included phases** | forward and backward passes, optimizer steps, gradient clipping, scheduled train and validation evaluation, learning-rate schedule |
| **Excluded phases** | dataset fetching and encoding, model construction, checkpoint serialization, report and provenance serialization |
| **Device synchronization** | synchronize immediately before and after the measured training-and-evaluation region |
| **Outer reference runs** | 5 |
| **Outer preconditioning runs** | 2 |
| **Outer inter execution cooldown seconds** | 0 |
| **Repeatability metric** | train_and_eval_seconds |
| **Repeatability limit** | 0.05 |

## Draft Reference Results

These project-generated measurements demonstrate the current `max` paths on the disclosed reference system. Five-run records passed the project quality and repeatability checks. Provisional records establish execution and quality only; they do not establish repeatability. None are MLCommons-verified results.

| **Case** | **Evidence** | **Runs** | **Reference measurement** | **Quality** | **Repeatability** | **System** |
|:---|:---|---:|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| inference / decode | One-run provisional | 1 | `output_tokens_per_sec` 767.276 mean | Performance-only case | Not established | Apple M5 Max; cpu |
| inference / full | One-run provisional | 1 | `output_tokens_per_sec` 695.511 mean | Performance-only case | Not established | Apple M5 Max; cpu |
| inference / prefill | One-run provisional | 1 | `prefill_tokens_per_sec` 24,568.4 mean | Performance-only case | Not established | Apple M5 Max; cpu |
| training | Two-run provisional | 2 | `train_and_eval_seconds` 2,107.4 mean | `cross_entropy_loss` 1.4590 mean; target ≤ 1.4697; **pass** | CV 5.19%; **diagnostic fail** | Apple M5 Max; mps |

> Five-run verified means eligible for the project's future promotion import. One-run and two-run provisional records are not review eligible and make no repeatability claim.
